summary: Ran `npx -y -p @angular/cli@20 ng update @angular/core@20 @angular/cli@20 --allow-dirty --force` from EFNgApp/EFNgApp/ClientApp on Node 22/npm 10, bumping @angular/* to 20.3.35, the CLI/build-angular toolchain to 20.3.43, @angular/compiler-cli and @angular/language-service to 20.3.35, and migrating tsconfig.json's `moduleResolution` from `node` to `bundler` plus angular.json schematics defaults. The automated update's mandatory migrations only touched one spec file (TestBed.get -> TestBed.inject); no component had its own build-breaking change this hop. Two manual fixes were needed to get `npm run build` green again. First, the new `bundler` moduleResolution now enforces package.json `exports` maps, which broke `@ngrx/effects@17.2.0`'s own type-only deep import of `@ngrx/store/src/models` (a path @ngrx/store's exports map doesn't expose) and an identical deep import in this app's own `src/app/state/reducers/employee.reducer.ts`; both were only resolvable before because `node` moduleResolution ignored exports maps. Fixed by bumping all five `@ngrx/*` packages from ^17.2.0 to ^20.1.0 (the first @ngrx major with an `@angular/core: ^20.0.0` peer range, and whose own .d.ts files no longer use the broken deep import) and rewriting the app's reducer to import `Action` from the public `@ngrx/store` entry point instead of the private path. Second, `npm install --legacy-peer-deps` was hoisting an invalid, unusable `ajv@6.15.0` at the top of node_modules (pulled in transitively by the optional `protractor` -> `webdriver-manager` -> `request` -> `har-validator` chain) where `ajv-keywords@5.1.0` (needed by @angular-devkit/build-angular's updated copy-webpack-plugin/schema-utils@4.8.3 chain) expected `ajv@^8.8.2`, causing `ng build` to crash with `Cannot find module 'ajv/dist/compile/codegen'` before any compilation happened; fixed with a root-level `"overrides": { "ajv": "^8.17.1" }` in package.json so npm resolves a single, compatible ajv version across the tree (protractor/e2e, which is optional and not a required check, is the only consumer that wanted ajv@6, and it only validates JSON schemas so ajv@8 is a safe substitute). Install and build both pass after these fixes; test fails the same pre-existing way as baseline and every prior hop (angular.json's test target points at root-level styles.css instead of src/styles.css, unchanged by this hop).
changes: @angular/cli migration: updated angular.json with default `schematics` settings (component/directive/service/guard/interceptor/module/pipe/resolver type suffixes) to preserve pre-v20 generator behaviour
@angular/core migration: replaced deprecated `TestBed.get` with `TestBed.inject` in src/app/services/employee.service.spec.ts

Upgraded @ngrx/effects, @ngrx/entity, @ngrx/router-store, @ngrx/store and @ngrx/store-devtools from ^17.2.0 to ^20.1.0, since @ngrx/effects@17's and this app's own deep import of `@ngrx/store/src/models` is no longer resolvable once tsconfig's moduleResolution enforces package.json exports maps
Manual fix in src/app/state/reducers/employee.reducer.ts: import `Action` from the public `@ngrx/store` entry point instead of the private `@ngrx/store/src/models` path

Added `overrides: { ajv: "^8.17.1" }` to package.json so the build-angular webpack toolchain's required ajv@^8.8.2 wins over an invalid ajv@6.15.0 hoisted from the optional protractor/request/har-validator chain, which was otherwise crashing `ng build` with a missing-module error before any compilation
package-lock.json regenerated by npm as part of the update/install cycles
manual_followups: npm install still needs legacy-peer-deps (set project-wide via ClientApp/.npmrc in an earlier hop) because @nguniversal/module-map-ngfactory-loader@7.1.0 declares peers on an old @angular/* major; it should be replaced by @angular/ssr (the @nguniversal scope was merged into @angular/ssr from Angular 17 onward) in a later hop. The .npmrc override can likely be removed once that is resolved.

`npm run test` fails before any spec executes because angular.json's test architect target still points at `styles.css` at the ClientApp root instead of `src/styles.css`; this predates this hop (present since baseline) and was left as-is per the rule that pre-existing failures don't need fixing.

`npm run build:ssr` (not a required check) reports the same two pre-existing TypeScript errors from @types/jasmine and @types/ws type-definition conflicts as the previous hop; verified unchanged by this hop's changes.

The root-level `overrides: { ajv: "^8.17.1" }` added this hop forces ajv@8 on the optional protractor -> webdriver-manager -> request -> har-validator chain, which originally wanted ajv@^6.5.0; this is safe for the required checks (protractor/e2e is optional and not run) but worth revisiting if a later hop needs to actually run protractor e2e tests, or once protractor/har-validator are removed from the optional dependencies.

Angular 20's optional 'use-application-builder' migration (webpack-based builder to the new esbuild/vite-based application builder) and 'control-flow-migration'/'router-current-navigation' migrations were not applied, to keep this hop's change minimal; worth revisiting in a later hop.
